Mar. 13, 1.''}}* the daies vvil come vvherein {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ This was fulfilled 40 years after the death of Christ, the 19. of August, being the very month}}∷ there shal not be left a stone vpon a stone that shal not be destroied. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=7}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ TVESDAY night.}}∷ And they asked him, saying, Maister, When shal these things be: and vvhat shal be the signe vvhen they shal begin to come to passe? {{verse|chapter=21|verse=8}}† VVho said, See you be not seduced. for {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Many false-prophets & Heretics. See An. Mt. 24. Mr. 13.}}∷ many vvil come in my name, saying that I am he: and the time is at hand, goe not therfore after them. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=9}}† b {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel upon. SS. Vincentius' and Anastasius' day. Ian. 22. And for many Martyrs.}}And vvhen you shal heare of vvarres and seditions, be not terrified: these things must first come to passe, but the end is not yet by and by. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=10}}† Then he said to them, Nation shal rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=11}}† And there shal be great earth-quakes in places, and pestilences and famines, and terrours from heauen, and there shal be great signes. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=12}}† But before al these things they vvil {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Great persecution of Catholike men.}}∷ lay their hands vpon you: and persecute you deliuering you into synagogs and prisons, dravving you to kings and presidents for my name. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=13}}† and it shal happen vnto you for testimonie. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=14}}† Lay vp this therfore in your hartes, not to premeditate hovv you shal ansvver. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=15}}† For I vvil giue you mouth and vvisedom, vvhich al your aduersaries shal not be able to resist and gainesay. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=16}}† And you shal be deliuered vp of your parents and brethren, and kinsemen & frendes: and they vvil put to death of you. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=17}}† And you shal be odious to al men for my name: {{verse|chapter=21|verse=18}}† and a heare of your head shal not perish. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=19}}† In your patience you shal possesse your soules.⊣

{{verse|chapter=21|verse=20}}† And vvhen you shal see Hierusalem compassed about vvith an armie: then knovv that the desolation thereof is at hand. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=21}}† then they that are in Ievvrie, let them flee to the mountaines: and they in the middes thereof, let them depart: and they in the countries, let them not enter into it. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=22}}† for these are the daies of vengeance, that al things may be fulfilled that are vvritten. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=23}}† But vvo to them that are vvith childe and that giue sucke in those daies. for there shal be great affliction vpon the land, and vvrath on this people. {{verse|chapter=21|verse=24}}† And they shal fall by the edge of the svvord: and shal be led captiue into al nations. and Hierusalem shal be troden of the Gentiles: til the times of nations be fulfilled.

{{verse|chapter=21|verse=25}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Eze. 32, 7. Ioel. 3, 15.''}}* {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ The Gospel vpō the 1 Sunday in Aduent.}}∷ And there shal be signes in the sunne and the moone and the starres: and vpon earth distresse of nations, for the confusion of the sound of sea and vvaues, {{verse|chapter=21|verse=26}}† men<noinclude>{{rh|||withering}}</noinclude>
